title: Mr. T's Fake WoW Class Became a Real Item
hook: In 2007 Mr. T told TV audiences he played a Night Elf Mohawk, a class that did not exist. Two years later Blizzard put a five-charge Mohawk Grenade in the game so you could give one to anybody. Did you ever get hit with one?
script: Did you know Mr. T's joke about a Night Elf Mohawk became a real item in World of Warcraft? In November two thousand seven, Blizzard launched a run of TV ads where celebrities described their characters. William Shatner said he played a shaman. Mr. T said he played a Night Elf Mohawk, and he pitied the fool who pointed out that no such class existed. The game had more than nine million subscribers at the time, and every ad ended by asking, what's your game? Two years later Blizzard brought him back for a sequel ad, and this time they made the joke true. On November sixteenth, two thousand nine, Night Elf Mohawk characters appeared outside every starting zone in North America. Talk to one and he handed you a free Mohawk Grenade with five charges. Throw it at other players and everyone in the blast got a Night Elf mohawk on their head for fifty minutes. The buff was called Mohawked, and the flavor text simply read, you pity the fool. Europe and Korea got their grenades about a week later. So a fake class invented for a commercial ended up as a real item players could throw at each other. Did you ever get Mohawked back in Wrath? Follow for more gaming history.
